subject: The two producers of miss between a gun's aim and a shell's flight: the per-shot Throw cone drawn in BSP_Gun_Fire 00730160, and the gun bot's aim error pair rerolled by 006DEFF0. Ghidra was read-only for this packet.
reuses: include/bsp/random.hpp for RandomState and random_next_u32_00ba2c20; 00BD2E60's uniform mapping sits on top of it
include/bsp/unit_rudder.hpp for wrapped_angle_add_00438aa0, the wrap the bot's error pair is applied through
include/bsp/gun_bot_ticks.hpp already has gun_bot_muzzle_error_006df520, the interpolation between the two error pairs; this packet adds the draw that feeds it and does not duplicate it
docs/ROBOT_CONFIG.md and include/bsp/robot_config.hpp for the six-level descriptor shape and the ArtilleryGunnerBot / ArtillerySubDirectorBot / TailGunnerBot field names
std::array<float,3> as the house float3, per include/bsp/camera_affine.hpp

brief_correction.was: the per-pellet perturbation is 0072F830, which builds a perturbation of the muzzle direction from the weapon class field Throw
brief_correction.is: 0072F830 contains exactly one RNG call, an effect timer, and one deterministic ring; the Throw cone is drawn in its caller BSP_Gun_Fire 00730160 at 00730540..0073058F
brief_correction.evidence: the only CALL 00BD2F10 inside 0072F830..0073015C is at 0072FB6A and its result is stored to gun[+3F0h]+6F8h; the 0072FEFB loop's angle is 2*pi*i/gunclass[+0CCh] with no draw; 00730557 and 00730575 are the two draws that write gun+400h and gun+404h

functions.name: BSP_Gun_Fire
functions.abi: __thiscall(gun, int useExplicitThrow, float throwA, float throwB), RET 0Ch at 00730A1B, body 00730160-00730A1D. Three stack arguments from the cleanup, not from the decompiler; frame A is entry-108h after SUB ESP,0FCh / PUSH EBP / PUSH ESI / PUSH EDI, which puts the arguments at [ESP+10Ch], [ESP+110h] and [ESP+114h].
functions.coverage: partial: 0073031D..0073075E complete; head 00730160..0073031C and tail 00730762..00730A1B by call shape only
functions.note: The throw magnitude starts as gun[+3F8h]+4h (the Lua Throw), is zeroed when weapon Function gunclass[+80h] is 1, 5 or 6 under GameSettings+760h (TurnOffAAGunThrow), and is multiplied by one seat's vtable[24h]() BulletThrowMul. A magnitude at or below zero skips the block. The draw is throwA = U(0, 2*pi) and throwB = tan(magnitude) * U(0, 1); the direction becomes row2 + throwB*(cos(throwA)*row1 + sin(throwA)*row0) of the barrel node matrix at gun[+3CCh]+0F0h.

The power is t^k, not 2^(k*t): 006DF065 pushes k and 006DF069 pushes t on top of it, and FYL2X computes ST(1)*log2(ST(0)).

distributions.name: per-shot throw cone
distributions.rule: throwA = U(0, 2*pi); throwB = tan(Throw') * U(0, 1), where Throw' is the authored Throw after the TurnOffAAGunThrow gate and the seat's BulletThrowMul. The direction becomes forward + throwB*(cos(throwA)*up + sin(throwA)*right) and is not renormalised, so the realised half-angle is atan(throwB).
distributions.shape: uniform in roll, uniform in radius (not in area), so the areal density falls off as 1/r and the mean miss angle is half the maximum
distributions.authored_inputs: Throw at gun[+3F8h]+4h from 007313E0; TurnOffAAGunThrow at GameSettings+760h from 0083B5E0; BulletThrowMul per robot class from 00901610's readers; unit+63Ch for bullet sub-types 4..7 (producer unread); gameplay-modifier category 7 through 00470440

distributions.name: gun bot aim error pair
distributions.rule: r = U(0, MaxAngleError) * U(0,1)^Power; phi = U(0, 2*pi); pair = (r*sin(phi), r*cos(phi)) radians. Applied as two wrapped angle additions to the arc solution at 006DFB1C and 006DFB36.
distributions.shape: uniform in roll; the magnitude is a product of two independent draws, centre-heavy already at Power = 1 and pulled towards zero for Power > 1
distributions.authored_inputs: ArtilleryGunnerBot level fields MaxAngleError (+0Ch) and Power (+10h), produced by read_ArtilleryGunnerBot_parameters_008FD370 out of Robots.lua. The 3-8 second reroll period is hard-coded at 00CE3854 and 00CE3918.

corrections.was: 006DEFF0 re-rolls the error envelope with 2^(k*rand(0,1)), k from descriptor + 10h + skill*1Ch
corrections.is: the weight is rand(0,1)^Power, and the routine also reads descriptor+0Ch, MaxAngleError, as the magnitude bound
corrections.evidence: 006DF065 FLD [ESP+0Ch] pushes k and 006DF069 FLD [ESP+4] pushes the draw on top of it; FYL2X at 006DF06D computes ST(1)*log2(ST(0)) = k*log2(draw), so 2^that is draw^k. 006DF09D FLD [EDX+ECX*4+0Ch] with ECX = 7*bot[+34h] is the second field.

corrections.was: 006DF520's descriptor fields +18h, +1Ch, +20h and +24h are the four lead scalars and +14h the lead re-roll period
corrections.is: they are SectionTargetChance, EngineRoomWeight, MagazineWeight, FueltankWeight and TargetPointRefreshTime - the target-section weights, not lead coefficients
corrections.evidence: read_ArtilleryGunnerBot_parameters_008FD370 binds those five Lua keys to those offsets; the rows are tabulated at src/robot_config.cpp:216 and the struct at include/bsp/robot_config.hpp:244

the spread is zeroed for weapon types 1, 5 and 6 under a settings flag, then scaled by the ammo provider through 00521E70
corrections.is: 00521E70 is an AI-role test on the owning unit (gun+3F0h), and the scale comes from vtable[24h] on one of six seat pointers at gun+390h..+3A4h chosen by bullet sub-type
corrections.evidence: 00521E70's complete body reads unit[+1ACh + role*4]; the shared tail at 00730491 loads [ECX] from the seat, and each dispatch arm sets ECX from a different gun+39xh slot before jumping there

corrections.was: 0072F830 builds a perturbation of the muzzle direction from the weapon class field Throw
corrections.is: 0072F830 has one RNG call, an effect timer at 0072FB6A, and one deterministic ring; the Throw cone is in BSP_Gun_Fire 00730160
corrections.evidence: the 0072FEFB loop's angle is FILD i, FMUL [00CE3828], FIDIV [gunclass+0CCh] with no draw anywhere in 0072FEDE..00730080; the two draws that write gun+400h and gun+404h are at 00730557 and 00730575

open_questions: The writer of gun+390h..+3A4h. The role-2..7 indexing is derived from the four-byte covariance of offset and role id across the five dispatch arms, not from a producer, and every BulletThrowMul claim rests on it.

Which gameplay-modifier category 7 is. The 0Ch-stride table at [00F88C30]+88h is consumed by 00470440 and never traced; category 8 is the reload rate per docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md, so one producer read would name both.
The producer of unit+63Ch, the per-unit radius multiplier applied at 007305D6 for bullet sub-types 4, 5, 6 and 7.
0085C3F0's contract. Only its entry and argument binding were read; the axis-angle reading is provisional and the torpedo fan depends on it.
006FDD00 and the 00B63F10 look-at that build 0072F830's ring basis; the header takes the two axes as parameters because their provenance is unread.

Which of the two per-thread MT19937 streams is replicated. Every dispersion draw uses stream 1 (MOV ECX,1); what uses stream 0, and whether 00BD2ED0's fallback state at 00E14748 is ever reached on the game thread, was not established.
Why 0073062C scales the roll angle throwA by the gameplay modifier as well as the radius. It is harmless at 1.0f but is not a rotation-invariant scaling.
